info.title: Oreno Platform API
info.description:
The multi-tenant hiring and workforce-management platform API.

Authentication uses an opaque session cookie set by `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.
Requests that change state must also echo the CSRF token from the `oreno_csrf` cookie
in the header named by `csrfHeaderName` in the login response.

Every response uses one of two envelopes: `{ data, meta }` on success, and
`{ error: { code, message, requestId } }` on failure. `code` is stable and safe to
switch on; `message` is safe to display.

get.description: Answers whether the process is running. Must never touch a dependency: a failing database should not cause an orchestrator to restart a healthy process.
Answers whether the process can serve traffic by checking its dependencies. Responds `503` when a required dependency is unavailable so a load balancer holds traffic back.

503.description: At least one required dependency is unavailable.

get.description: Only mounted when `METRICS_ENABLED=true`. Exposes counters and histograms as JSON to keep the deployment free of a Prometheus sidecar.

200.description: A point-in-time snapshot of the in-process metrics registry.

post.description: Registers an account and sends a verification email. The account cannot sign in until the address is verified, so registration deliberately does not return a session.

201.description: Account created. The response carries no session by design.

post.description: On success, sets the session and CSRF cookies. When the account has two-factor authentication enabled and no code was supplied, responds `401` with code `TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED` rather than a session.

200.description: Signed in. Session and CSRF cookies are set on this response.
